title: Exactness of the pro-etale inverse image for constant coefficients
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite discrete ring (not necessarily commutative), let $u:U\to V$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and use the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] with coefficient sheaves $\Lambda_{U,\Proet},\Lambda_{V,\Proet}$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write $L=u^{-1}$ for the inverse image of the induced morphism of sites [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] and $c:L\Lambda_{V,\Proet}\xrightarrow{\sim}\Lambda_{U,\Proet}$ for the canonical structure map [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map]. For a sheaf $F$ of left $\Lambda_{V,\Proet}$-modules, define $u^*F$ as $LF$ with its left $\Lambda_{U,\Proet}$-action transported through $c$: $r\cdot m=c^{-1}(r)m$. On morphisms use $L$. For commutative $\Lambda$ this is naturally isomorphic to the module inverse image of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Then $u^*$ is exact on these categories of left module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]: it preserves kernels and cokernels, and carries every short exact sequence to a short exact sequence.

proof.text: On the AsSmall models of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], the base-change functor preserves finite limits, so is representably flat. Transport the RingCat inverse-image adjunction through the strict AsSmall sheaf equivalences. Its unit is exactly finiteCoefficientModelRingUnit. Compare it with model-site RingCat pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints. Commuting the underlying-set functor past filtered left Kan extension and sheafification using [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-pullback-forget-comparison] gives a ring unit presentation. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-module-inverse-image-action-adjunction] to identify model module inverse image on underlying abelian sheaves, then transport back. Mathlib gives finite-limit preservation of abelian inverse image from flatness and finite-colimit preservation from its adjunction.

proof.text: The construction in step 1 transports addition and the scalar action along finite products, using the generic module-action adjunction [lem-weil-pbc-module-inverse-image-action-adjunction]. Restrict the action along the inverse of the canonical coefficient isomorphism [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map]. Additivity follows from the model pullback-pushforward adjunction and sectionwise additivity of both AsSmall transports and scalar restriction. Forgetting commutativity preserves sheafification since it changes no local injectivity or surjectivity condition. For the canonical commutative constant coefficient map, compose the constant-sheaf adjunction at a terminal object with inverse image/direct image. Site base change preserves that terminal object. Uniqueness of left adjoints gives an isomorphism to the source constant sheaf; its Hom equation identifies its forward map with the specified constant-section map. For the commutative tensor comparison [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], first build the adjunction of the specified noncommutative pullback to module pushforward: transport Mathlib model-site pullback/pushforward through the AsSmall module equivalences and restriction along the coefficient isomorphism. The right adjoint has coefficient map rho, the adjunct of c, hence is the specified direct image. Prove the coefficient-comparison square by precomposing with the constant sheafification unit: both sides then send a constant to the same pulled-back constant section, so sheafification uniqueness gives equality. Restriction along the canonical commutative coefficient identifications is an equivalence on module categories. Conjugate the first adjunction by these equivalences. The coefficient square identifies its right adjoint with the direct image adjoint to the actual sheafified tensor pullback, as supplied by proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction. Uniqueness of left adjoints and the source equivalence unit give the required natural isomorphism. All helpers and the final comparison are proved; no tensor-comparison hole remains.

source.place: Tag 03D2, lemma-pullback-module, construction and proof; tensor cancellation along the ring isomorphism is elementary

proof.text: Restriction of scalars leaves the underlying abelian sheaf and maps unchanged. Compose its identity underlying comparison with the comparison from step 1. For any short exact sequence, map it by the exact module-to-abelian forgetful functor, then by abelian inverse image. Transport along that natural isomorphism and reflect short exactness through the faithful exact target forgetful functor. Mathlib Functor.exact_tfae turns preservation of all short exact sequences by this additive functor into preservation of finite limits and finite colimits.
